# Moviefone

> > Moviefone is your comprehensive guide to finding, watching, and discovering movies and TV shows across theaters and streaming platforms.

Moviefone provides an all-in-one entertainment discovery platform featuring movie and TV show browsing, local theater showtimes, streaming availability across major services, trending charts, reviews, and exclusive celebrity content. The site aggregates entertainment data with personalized recommendations to help users decide what to watch.

## Key Topics

- Movie showtimes
- Streaming guides
- TV shows
- Movie database
- Genre filtering
- Where to watch
- New releases
- In-theaters
- Streaming rankings
- Box office
- Movie trailers
- Entertainment news
- Regional charts
- Celebrity profiles
- Movie discovery

## Browse Movies & TV

- [Movies](https://www.moviefone.com/movies): Browse movies by genre, popularity, and streaming availability
- [TV Shows](https://www.moviefone.com/tv-shows): Browse TV shows by genre and popularity with streaming options
- [Movies in Theaters](https://www.moviefone.com/movies/in-theaters): Browse current theatrical releases with showtimes and genre filtering
- [Movies Coming Soon](https://www.moviefone.com/movies/coming-soon): Explore upcoming theatrical releases with genre filtering and calendars
- [Popular Celebrities](https://www.moviefone.com/celebrity): Browse celebrity profiles and find movies by favorite actors

## Streaming & Discovery

- [Streaming Movies & TV Shows](https://www.moviefone.com/streaming): Discover streaming content across services with trending and new releases
- [What to Watch on Streaming](https://www.moviefone.com/what-to-watch): Get personalized streaming recommendations across Netflix, Prime, Disney+
- [Movie Charts in United States](https://www.moviefone.com/streaming/movies/charts): View trending movie charts by region and genre with streaming rankings
- [Show Charts in United States](https://www.moviefone.com/streaming/tv-shows/charts): View trending TV show charts by region and genre with popularity data

## Showtimes & Theaters

- [Find Movie Showtimes Near You](https://www.moviefone.com/showtimes): Search local theater showtimes by movie, date, and location
- [Movie Theaters](https://www.moviefone.com/showtimes/theaters): Browse movie theater chains and locations with showtimes

## Reviews & Details

- [Movie Reviews](https://www.moviefone.com/movies/reviews): Read movie reviews and ratings with critic scores and film database
- [Movie Detail Pages](https://www.moviefone.com/movie/ready-or-not/3pRJTsTfE2pIFAOF13LUf6/main): Individual movie detail page with streaming options and showtimes

## Videos & Trailers

- [New Movie Trailers](https://www.moviefone.com/videos/movie-trailers): Watch HD movie trailers and previews for upcoming releases
- [Moviefone Videos](https://www.moviefone.com/videos): Original Moviefone video series, trailers, and exclusive interviews
- [Moviefone TV - Videos](https://www.moviefone.com/videos/moviefone-tv): Exclusive celebrity interviews and behind-the-scenes from blockbusters

## News & Entertainment

- [News](https://www.moviefone.com/news): Latest movie and TV news with interviews, reviews, and casting updates
- [Movie and TV Highlights](https://www.moviefone.com/highlights): Curated highlights of trending blockbusters and binge-worthy series
- [Made In Hollywood](https://www.moviefone.com/made-in-hollywood): Weekly series with celebrity interviews and Hollywood behind-the-scenes

## Optional

- [Homepage](https://www.moviefone.com): Homepage offering movie/TV streaming guides, showtimes, and theater listings
